items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: The interviewee confirms the interviewer's statement that 'Rublo was playing Dying Job' and mentions 'Rubio playing' in the context of a band lineup, but does not describe a direct personal interaction or collaboration with Rublo himself.
